purpose: The only commands a progress receipt may run against loop-hybrid. A progress event names a check id from this file and never a command string, because re-running a command an agent wrote into an event is arbitrary execution driven by that agent. Sealed in governance/decision-seal.json: editing a check here without a reseal in the same pull request breaks the seal.
target_project_note: Every command below runs in a verifier snapshot of this repository and proves something about it alone. Registered 2026-08-10 under the owner ruling (option A) that closes external-host's docs/open-questions/loop-hybrid-has-no-check-registry.md — before this file existed, HOST-CHECK-OWNERSHIP-014 consequence 2 meant every loop-hybrid receipt request was refused by design, so demo-scope crossings could never finalize.

lh-gate-pack-verify.description: The committed gate-pack (npm test) — this repository's own verification authority.

lh-lint.description: Shell syntax checks plus a compile pass over gate-pack and lh_runtime Python (npm run lint).

cannot_claim: that a green check is target acceptance or promotion; terminal human acceptance stays outside machine completion
that any project other than target_project can be verified from here
that running as the same user makes the check untamperable; the seal removes 'claimed without doing', not 'edited the check'
